messages:
maria (partnerships): Quick heads-up — we need to lock down SI co-sell handoff rules for the Dataplane + Nimble HW integration and the AWS Marketplace listing. timing: next sprint.
aj (sales): Ack. Are we reusing the existing SI claim window (48h) or tightening for marketplace leads?
kevin (solutions): For HW-enabled PoCs we should shorten to 24h for responsiveness. SI handoffs get messy if claims linger.
sandeep (si-engineering): 24h is fine, but we need a fallback if the SI is OOO or overloaded. Suggest auto-assign to regional field eng after 24h + 8h reminder.
maria (partnerships): Proposed rules: 1) inbound lead lands in CRM with partner tag (nimble_dataplane). 2) SI has 24h to claim; add comment + assign owner. 3) if unclaimed, auto-assign to AM pool for that region. 4) if claimed but no activity in 3 days => escalate to partner lead.
linda (legal): Also add an NDA / data handling checkpoint for HW PoCs — signature required before any device-level access. We should block handoff until NDA is flagged in SFDC.
aj (sales): How do we capture claim action in CRM? We need a single checkbox or stage transition, not freeform comments.
kevin (solutions): Add a custom picklist: Partner_Claim_Status = [unclaimed, claimed_by_SI, claimed_by_AM, escalated]. Use for reporting.
partner-bot: Reminder: new SFDC field proposal posted at https://confluence.redwood/partners/fields (mock).
sandeep (si-engineering): For routing: prefer SI by account territory mapping first, then if tooling shows >70% confidence for alternate SI, allow swap after ops approval.
maria (partnerships): Routing matrix: - Account ARR > $250k => dedicated SI route (manual claim) - ARR 50-250k => auto-route by territory - ARR < 50k => marketplace self-serve / CS-assisted.
aj (sales): Compensation note — credits/split for SI-influenced bookings? Need to confirm with Rev Ops.
linda (legal): If we do referral fees, get written MSA addendum. I can draft a short template.
kevin (solutions): Quick checklist for handoff message to SI (to be automated): ```Account name, ARR, contact list (roles), PoC hardware requirements, PoC timeline target, NDA status (Y/N), initial ask (demo/POC/proof), Redwood contact, Marketplace listing ID```
sandeep (si-engineering): Also include the tech contact's public SSH key fingerprint if device access is needed — security team requires it.
maria (partnerships): Operational items: - Intake form must be mandatory for partner-sourced leads - Tagging schema: nimble:hw, marketplace:aws, si:claimed_by_<siname> - SLA timers in Ops queue - Weekly sweep for unclaimed >72h
aj (sales): Can we get a lightweight intake UI (Formstack) that writes the fields into SFDC and triggers partner-bot? saves a lot of back-and-forth.
partner-bot: New intake form prototype ready at https://forms.redwood/new-intake (staging).
kevin (solutions): We'll test the prototype with 2 pilot accounts next week. Volunteers: AJ and Sandeep to run.
sandeep (si-engineering): I can own the pilot tech validation, AJ will handle customer comms.
linda (legal): For the pilot, use the experimental clause in our partner pilot MSA. I'll attach the clause to the pilot intake confirmation.
maria (partnerships): Escalation path summary (to be added to playbook): 1) SI claim within 24h 2) If no claim -> AM pool assign 3) If claim with no activity in 72h -> partner lead escalation 4) If legal/KYC missing -> handoff paused until resolved.
aj (sales): Do we want a single Slack channel for claimed handoffs so SIs and AMs can triage quickly?
kevin (solutions): Yes — create #si-handoffs with thread per account (automated from partner-bot). Keep sensitive details out of channel.
linda (legal): Agreed on channel but mask PII. Use ticket links to SFDC for sensitive docs.
maria (partnerships): Action items: - Linda to draft NDA/msa addendum (ETA 3 days) - DevOps to push intake form into staging (partner-bot) - Rev Ops to confirm compensation language (AJ follow) - Sandeep + AJ run 2 pilots next week.
aj (sales): I'll ping Rev Ops now. :+1:
sandeep (si-engineering): I can prep the tech checklist and sample server images.
partner-bot: Reminder scheduled: Pilot kickoff sync Thu 10am PT.
maria (partnerships): Thanks everyone — will update the playbook doc and post link here once NDA + intake form are live. :rocket:
